g.text: Grenzwertgeber (PTC) test set - analogue front end
Note 1 R1 = 159.1 R, measured -- not read off a colour code and not
back-calculated from the two ADC channels. Build it from standard
Enter the measured value in firmware/gwg_tester/config.h as R_SERIES.
Note 2 C1 and C2 are DNP. If fitted, fit BOTH with the same value: the
current is the difference of the two channels, so asymmetric
filtering feeds the full supply ripple into the current reading
instead of cancelling it. A capacitor on node A alone also stretches
the settle time and blocks the pulsed measurement while cooling.
Note 3 Tie the 19 V supply ground to module ground. Power MOD1 from USB-C,
Note 4 R2 keeps a defined current flowing with no probe fitted, so
open-circuit detection cannot read a plausible value off a floating
node. It is divided out in firmware: R_DIV_A = 110k || 1M = 99.1k.
Note 5 GPIO32/33 are on ADC1. ADC2 is unusable while WiFi is active.
GPIO0 and GPIO35 are the on-board buttons, no external wiring.
WARNING Not intrinsically safe. Do not test in fuel oil or a hazardous area.
